parameter.name: NUMS
parameter.what: how many of the bank's modes carry a numerator, i.e. how many can be band-pass or high-pass filters rather than bare bodies. The dial the mode-count debate never looked at, and the one the objective is actually sensitive to.

objective.name: modal_dp cell area
objective.why: the same objective as drum-kit-modes, measured on the block the dial acts on. modal_dp rather than drum_kit because the artefact sweeps NUMS across three values only on modal_dp; drum_kit has two, which cannot show a shape.

range_basis: Every value fpga/scripts/mode_sweep.sh synthesised for modal_dp at MODES = 16, MW = 4. As with drum-kit-modes, the grid is asserted to BE that set, not chosen from it.

6 is what the kit shipped at when the debate happened; 11 is what a complete 808 needs (docs/integration-area.md section 3) and what the tree ships today; 16 is the dial at its maximum, every mode a filter.
The endpoints bracket the whole usable range, so a flat verdict here could not be an artefact of a narrow grid.

decision_rule.why: the same rule as drum-kit-modes, deliberately: the two dials are being compared, so scoring them by different thresholds would decide the comparison by choosing the thresholds. ~6,400 um2 per mode against drum_kit at MODES = 12 is 1.06 %, rounded up to 2 %.

evidence.instrument: yosys synth + abc -liberty via rtl-sketch/area/synth_area.py, klt's recipe, gf180mcu_fd_sc_mcu7t5v0 tt_025C_5v00, CELL area only. NOT placed, NOT routed.

prediction.basis: Stated from the RTL, not from these numbers. modal_dp gives the excitation-history pair h1, h2 only to modes below NUMS (21 bits each, 42 flops per slot) and yosys genuinely prunes them above it -- unlike the y1/y2/exc state arrays, which every mode has and which are what gets padded to a power of two. A pruned per-slot resource is a slope, so no two grid points can coincide and every adjacent pair must separate. Three runs.

verdict.summary: A slope: +6.35 % from 6 to 11 and +7.52 % from 11 to 16, both far outside the 2 % rule, ~4,190 um2 per numerator slot. Set beside drum-kit-modes this is the whole finding of failure-modes mechanism 5 in two lines -- the dial that was argued about is flat across the range that was argued about, and the dial nobody looked at is the one the objective responds to.

limits: Held at MODES = 16, which the tree ships; the slope was not measured at other mode counts. h1/h2 are per-slot and pruned above NUMS, so the slope should not depend on MODES, but that is a prediction here rather than a measurement.

modal_dp alone, not drum_kit. The drum_kit rows at MODES = 16 give 607,051.8 at NUMS = 6 and 630,432.9 at NUMS = 11 -- +3.85 %, still outside the rule, so the verdict does not change at kit level, but the kit sweep has only two points and is not this record's evidence.
Cell area, not routed area, and not correctness.

retrofit.of: the variable docs/failure-modes.md mechanism 5 names as the one that actually mattered
retrofit.why: the measurements predate the record, so the grid and rule were written knowing the answer. The prediction block is the part that is not retrospective.
retrofit.prospective_from: tools/sweep_m1a_attack.py's pattern -- grid committed and clean before any point is rendered; see docs/sensitivity-sweeps.md.
